scientific_integrity: The result is a self-contained symbolic classification using standard induced-representation matrices and a rank-one determinant constraint; finite arithmetic checks are supplementary, not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one fixed two-dimensional irreducible of a finite generalized dihedral group. It does not classify sums of Fourier blocks or rank-two coefficients. Full historical equivalence is not certified.
title: Zero-mask rigidity for rank-one generalized-dihedral Fourier coefficients
